"JOINT MEMO Parties above named begs to submit as under;

Bhatkal came to be dissolved vide decree dated 16.06.2025 passed in MC No.2716/2024 by Vth Addl.

3.

(5) The petitioner has agreed to pay a sum of Rs.8,50,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs Fifty Thousand Only) to the respondent towards maintenance/permanent alimony as full and final settlement of all her claims.

Out of the said amount the Rs.4,00,000/-
NC: 2026:KHC:10998 HC-KAR (Rupees Four Lakhs Only) will be paid by the petitioner to the respondent by way of electronic transfer to the respondent's account at the time of reporting settlement before the Hon'ble Court.

The remaining balance amount of Rs.4,50,000/- (Rupees Four Lakhs Fifty Thousand Only) will be paid by the petitioner to the respondent by way of electronic transfer to the respondent's account at the time of quashing/closing the Crime No.222/2021 which is pending 37th ACMM, Bengaluru.

(9) In view of this settlement the respondent has agreed to co-operate in closing/quashing the proceedings in Crime No.222/2021 filed at Basavanagudi Women's Police Station filed against the petitioner and other family members for the offence punishable under Section 498-A, 504 of IPC R/w Section 4 of D.P Act which pending before 37th ACMM, Bengaluru.

Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 admit the contents of the joint memo and respondent No.2 specifically states that the dispute between her and petitioner No.1 is settled amicably and she has no objection to allow the petition and to quash the criminal proceedings.
7. Respondent No.2 acknowledges receipt of Rs.4 lakhs paid on 16.06.2025 and also receipt of the demand draft for Rs.4,50,000/- dated 22.01.2026 as referred to in the joint memo.
She has no further claim against the petitioner herein.
8. Joint memo, joint affidavit and the submissions are placed on record.

9. In view of the above, the petition is liable to be allowed.

ORDER (i) Criminal Petition is allowed.
(ii) The criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners pending in Cr.No.222/2021 NC: 2026:KHC:10998 HC-KAR on the file of the learned 37th Additional C.M.M. Court, Bengaluru, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 504 of IPC R/w Section 4 of DP Act 1961, is hereby quashed.
In view of disposal of the main petition, pending IA No.1/2025 stands disposed off.
